overall.summary: Apple's Q3 2025 10-Q shows a significant pattern of risk factor disclosure removal compared to the Q2 2025 filing. Multiple material risk categories — including supply chain geographic concentration, tariff/geopolitical exposure, operational risks, regulatory investigations (Section 232 semiconductor probe), and margin pressure factors — appear to have been stripped from the filing. Additionally, the capital return program disclosure was made less specific by removing the remaining buyback authorization amount and the $100 billion program reference. While some of these removals may reflect 10-Q risk factor incorporation by reference from the 10-K, the breadth and specificity of what was removed — particularly named countries, named investigations, and quantified authorization amounts — suggests a deliberate reduction in disclosure granularity.
